requests.locator: zero-based code cells 6 and 15; ws_r assignments and scarcity handling

facts.monthly_raw: withdrawals / available supply; zero/near-zero supply becomes 9999; arid flag sets raw=1 and category=-1
facts.annual_raw: demand-weighted monthly ratios; monthly 9999 replaced by 2 for weighting; six or more scarcity months force annual 9999; annual no-supply/arid overrides follow
facts.interpretation: Observed raw ratios >1 agree with producer code. Technical-note clipping wording does not define the distributed raw-value domain. Preserve native category/label and raw value.

limits: Resolves encoding discrepancy, not four-class calibration or local livelihood interpretation.
Do not recompute an ordinary mean or ratio of annual totals from monthly data and label it the published annual BWS.
